about.title: About Paradise Bay
about.text: Nestled on the pristine shores of Exuma, Paradise Bay Bahamas is a boutique oceanfront resort offering private cottages and villas on a breathtaking 1.2-mile untouched beach, shielded by a natural coral reef. We are far from mass tourism — here you'll find peace, luxury, and the authentic beauty of the Bahamas. From boat excursions to kite-surfing, every moment is crafted for unforgettable memories.

testimonials.name: Victoria & James Hart
testimonials.text: Paradise Bay truly lives up to its name. The private beach was stunning, the cottage was luxurious, and the boat excursion to see the swimming pigs was a dream come true.

testimonials.name: Sophia Laurent
testimonials.text: The most peaceful and beautiful resort I've ever visited. Far from the tourist crowds, with crystal-clear water and impeccable service. We'll be back!

testimonials.name: Michael & Lisa Chen
testimonials.text: We booked the honeymoon package and it exceeded every expectation. The private villa, the romantic dinner on the beach — absolutely perfect in every way.
